Exact derivative factorization makes the optimizer the sole positive root of a cubic whose coefficient signs are (+,+,-,-), hence uniquely global by Descartes and endpoint signs. The equal-volume cube crossing follows from strict monotonicity and the below-limit asymptotics. The packaged exact symbolic and nine-hull tests succeeded; they corroborate, not replace, the analytic proof.
